description.en: Planned whole-organism study featuring broad lateral swimming lobes, forward spiny appendages and a long posterior spine.
description.zh: 拟议全体生物研究：宽侧游泳叶、前向多刺附肢及长尾刺。

scientific_scope.en: Genus-level body-form proposal supported by the named K. kierkegaardi specimens in Park et al. (2018); soft-tissue detail and artistic treatment remain separate.
scientific_scope.zh: 依据 Park 等（2018）具名 K. kierkegaardi 标本的属级体形方案；软组织细节与美术处理另行区分。

distinctness.en: Its distinguishing construction is broad lateral swimming lobes, forward spiny appendages and a long posterior spine; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
distinctness.zh: 以宽侧游泳叶、前向多刺附肢及长尾刺为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish broad lateral swimming lobes, forward spiny appendages and a long posterior spine in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以宽侧游泳叶、前向多刺附肢及长尾刺搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

assets.uncertainty: The 2018 specimens support one median unsegmented tail spine, revising older paired-tail interpretations. Do not reconstruct a paired tail from outdated artwork.
assets.reference_notes: Cambrian Stage 3 Sirius Passet specimens MGUH 32048–32062 support an oval flap outline and single median tail spine; no exact scene coexistence is implied.

sources.title: Brain and eyes of Kerygmachela reveal protocerebral ancestry of panarthropod head
sources.supports: Kerygmachela kierkegaardi Cambrian specimens: paired spiny frontal appendages, oval outline of lateral flaps and one median unsegmented tail spine, revising older paired-tail interpretations.
